answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Endowed ski instructor licence with snowsports institute attestation stops them at the door: a licence the institute renews after slope audits, which means the jade of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a licence the institute renews after slope audits is something they already have; the sonnet falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The river is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
